text:
maria-cs: Quick heads-up — I'm prepping a 15min demo for a customer next Tue to translate SLOs into customer-facing comms + a sample credits calc. Want to show: uptime language, latency buckets (p95/p99), and what evidence we attach. Draft slide + calc here: https://redwood.internal/sla-comm-draft (internal only).

ben-platform: Nice. Can you confirm the committed numbers we'll present? Is it 99.9% uptime and p95 250ms / p99 700ms for hosted? @eli-oncall

eli-oncall: For hosted tier that's the typical guidance: uptime 99.9% (monthly window). p95 250ms, p99 700ms — yes. Dedicated customers often land at p95 ~150ms. Also flag: our credit calc uses outage minutes * customer monthly spend * credit-factor. I can paste the formula.

sam-eng: Example numbers would help the CS playbook — customers always ask for a worked example. Also: what metric names should we link to in the evidence bundle?

maria-cs: Good call. Working on a 1-slide example and a 1-pager. Here's a quick formula snippet I plan to show:```
# credit calculation pseudo
outage_minutes = max(0, total_minutes_in_window - healthy_minutes)
credit_pct = min(1.0, outage_minutes / threshold_minutes * escalation_factor)
credit_amount = customer_monthly_commit * credit_pct
```
This is intentionally simplified — we'll include the official definition in the appendix.

eli-oncall: That looks fine for a demo. For threshold_minutes we use 43,200 (30 days * 24 * 60) and escalation_factor is 0.5 for the first tier, 1.0 for sustained outages per current policy. Also call out transient skews (DNS/mesh vs infra) so customers understand exclusions.

ben-platform: Can you add the console metric keys? e.g.: `service.uptime_percentage` and `latency.p95_ms` / `latency.p99_ms` — that'll make the evidence bundle reproducible.

maria-cs: Yup — I'll add the metric names and a short how-to: Export a 30-day CSV of `service.uptime_percentage` and `latency.*` from the Console, plus the incident ticket IDs. Thinking of a small checklist: evidence CSV, incident IDs, time-range, and screenshot of route-level dashboard.

sam-eng: Suggest we include a tiny sample CSV row and a screenshot template in the slide so CS can paste and send quickly. Also add a note about timezone normalization (all times UTC).

eli-oncall: I'll generate a sample evidence bundle for you tomorrow — will include: 30d uptime CSV, p95/p99 histograms, and an incident timeline (start/end) plus normalized UTC timestamps.

maria-cs: Amazing, thanks. One more ask: can we surface a pre-calculated credit example for a $50k/mo customer with a 120-minute outage? Quick math:
- threshold_minutes = 43200
- outage_minutes = 120
- escalation_factor = 0.5 (first tier)
=> credit_pct = (120 / 43200) * 0.5 = 0.001388... => credit_amount ~ $69.4
I'll round and show $70 in the slide as an approachable example. Thoughts?

eli-oncall: Math checks out. I'd also include a note that credits are pro-rated and subject to exclusions/per-policy verification.

evidence-bot: evidence-bot: SLO evidence bundle generated for demo: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/evidence/sample-bundle-2026-03-18.zip (internal).

maria-cs: Perfect — I'll fold that into the appendix and share the draft with the enablement channel tomorrow for feedback. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ben-platform: LGTM. If enablement wants a canned email template, ping me and I can help word it to match legal phrasing.

sam-eng: I'll add a tiny runbook snippet on how to pull the CSV:```
# pull 30d uptime via CLI
redwood-cli metrics get --name service.uptime_percentage --from 30d --format csv > uptime_30d.csv
```

maria-cs: Adding runbook snippet now. Last call: anything else to surface in the demo?

eli-oncall: Maybe a single slide about fallback behavior (how we automatically route to compatible model variants during capacity issues) so customers see resilience has product-level controls.

maria-cs: Good idea — adding a short note on fallback policies. Will post the draft link here when ready and then loop in enablement.

ben-platform: Thanks — and small nit: change the header to "How we measure SLOs & calculate credits" (customer-facing).

maria-cs: Will do. Outgoing: I'll post the draft by EOD PST and request review. :v:
